children.name: Set up this Task Group
children.description:
1. Add the three Evaluators and Squad PjM
2. Add the link to the google drive folder for this evaluation

children.name: Create Channel in DAS Venture Slack
children.description:
1. Create a slack channel for this Evaluation in the DAS Ventures workspace (NOT in the Cadre workspace)
2. Name the channel v_name-of-venture (good examples would be v_culturous-exchange, v_seattle-humane)
3. Add Evaluators to the slack channel: PdM, SA, UxR, and PjM

children.name: Add PjM to the Evaluation
children.description:
1. In the Squad Needs section, select the correct Venture, Add a role for Project Manager. Add the person to the PjM role you just created. 
2. Add the PjM to the google shared drive for the evaluation.
3. Add PjM to this taskgroup as a Responsible person.
4. Add the PjM to the venture Slack channel
5. Share the link to the Evaluation Contributor Tool with the PjM (note it is currently in development)

children.name: Create a central place to take collaborative notes
children.description:
Create a central Gdoc to take collaborative notes 
1. The document should be created in the Google Drive Folder for this Painpoint
2. Ensure each internal evaluators are aware of the expectation of collaborative note-taking during the call. 
3. Populate the note taking location with the Venture Evaluation Rubric / Checklist

children.name: Generate Approx. Squad Makeup
children.description:
Create approximate squad makeup, focusing on creating an initial list of ideal expertise/skills members of the squad might hold.On this taskgroup page, select the painpoint from the dropdown then add proposed squad members to the squad need section. 

All squads should include a User Researcher and a Product Manager

AC: Squad makeup of AirTable partner page, set to WIP

children.name: Synthesize cursory evaluations
children.description:
Ensure all three independent evaluations have occurred. 
Ensure there is alignment on the go/no go decision. Hold a synchronous meeting if need be.

If the decision is to reject the painpoint,
0. In the Collaborative Notes, summarize the reasons why the venture was not a good fit. 
1. In the Partner Relationships Slack channel, notify Partner Relationships team of the decision to decline the Venture and provide a summary of the reason(s) why. This will likely be a 2-3 sentence summary of the reasons listed in Collaborative Notes, excluding any internal deliberations, and cleaned up to be Partner-facing. Request that Partner Relationships communicate the rejection to the Partner.
2. Mark this task as Delivered
3. FIRST: Select the partner from the dropdown in the Staffing Needs section. THEN In the Update Venture Status section of this taskgroup, fill in the Reason for Declining Venture field, check the confirmation checkbox, and click the Decline Venture button.

If the decision is to proceed with evaluating the painpoint,
1. Notify the PjM that the Evaluation will proceed, and that they should move forward with scheduling a Painpoint Discovery meeting with the Partner
3. Mark this task Delivered and move onto the next task.

AC: Shared decision amongst the Evaluators to proceed with the Evaluation or to decline the Venture

children.name: Schedule Painpoint Discovery meeting with partner
children.description:
Coordinate scheduling of call.
Adjust the due dates for the "Engage in Initial Pain Point..." tasks for the team to the date of the call.

Note: notes during the call should be included in the Collaborative Notes document so that all questions and comments are easily accessible in one place. If desired, notes can be copied into the meeting notes in airtable.

AC:
Call on all attendees' calendars with video call link. From DAS, attendees should be Evaluators (Contributor PjM and Cadre Research, PdM, & Sol. Arch.)

children.description:
1. Evaluators (PdM and UxR) synchronously hand off the venture to the Squad (PdM, PjM, and UxR) in a video call. Solutions Architect should be included at your discretion. You can use the Squad Handoff Call Example Agenda

AC: Squad PdM, PjM, and UxR have taken responsibility for the Venture. Client has been informed that we have approved their venture, and that it is being handed off to a Squad.

children.name: Create tasks for Followup Survey and Retro
children.description:
Create tasks for yourself separate from this task group
(note: see team gdrive for documentation) 

Task 1
Name:
Send Survey

Description:
Send the post-handoff survey to the Squad PdM and Squad PjM.

Task 2
Name:
Schedule Followup Call (if needed)

Description:
Determine if a followup call is needed. If the survey respondents identify significant issues with the handoff, major discrepancies between the Charter and the Venture as it is being executed, or if clarification is needed on survey responses that cannot be done via Slack, schedule a followup call to discuss.

Task 3
Name:
Schedule a retro

Description:
Schedule a retrospective with the team of Evaluators (PdM, Solutions Architect, User Researcher). Notify the whole Venture Evaluation Team through Slack in case any others want to attend. 
Outcomes of the Retro should be shared with the team via slack and/or in the next team call.
